Subject: New vendor onboarding - W-9 attached (possible EIN mismatch)

Hi Rishi / Laura,

Thanks for the warm welcome — excited to get Orchid Data Solutions set up. Attached is our signed W-9 (orchid_w9_signed_v1.pdf). Quick heads up: the EIN printed on the W-9 is 12-3456789, which is the EIN for our U.S. selling entity (Orchid Data Solutions LLC). Our corporate filings sometimes show the parent company EIN (34-9876123) under Orchid Global Holdings, which is why you might see a mismatch if you cross-referenced our portal registration.

We want to make sure the PO is issued to the right legal name. Our preferred remit/payment name is Orchid Data Solutions LLC (EIN 12-3456789). Bank ACH is under Orchid Global Holdings for legacy reasons but we can provide an ACH addendum showing the link between entities.

Attachments: orchid_w9_signed_v1.pdf

Let me know if you need an IRS EIN confirmation letter or a notarized W-9. Happy to get this sorted quickly.

Best,
Samantha Reed

Thanks, Samantha — appreciate the quick response and the signed W-9. A couple of items we need to clear before Procurement can issue a PO: 

1) Can you send an IRS EIN confirmation (CP575 or EIN assignment letter) that ties the 12-3456789 EIN to Orchid Data Solutions LLC? That will let Finance reconcile vendor records.
2) If ACH is under Orchid Global Holdings, please provide a brief remittance explanation or an ACH addendum tying the accounts together (one page is fine).
3) Confirm the legal name to appear on the PO. My recommendation is to have the PO issued to the contracting party in the signed Master Services Agreement — is that Orchid Data Solutions LLC?

If you can get the EIN letter + a short remittance note by end of day Thursday (04/08), I can scope the PO draft and queue it with Finance. If anything will delay, flag it and we’ll scope an interim conditional PO with a payment hold.

Thanks — r
